data.name: Nothing Remarkable Today
data.detailed_description:
You are a junior editor at the city’s most trusted news agency.

Your task is simple: monitor the screens on the wall, write the notes, and decide what deserves attention.

Most days, nothing happens.

But sometimes, something does.

In Nothing Remarkable Today, the game does not guide you.
It does not warn you.
It does not react.

It remembers.

Every anomaly you notice.
Every detail you ignore.
Every moment you choose to wait.

There are no jump scares.
No dialogue.
No instructions.

Only observation.
And judgment.

Features:

  • Minimalist investigative gameplay

  • A silent system that records your choices

  • Multiple endings based on what you chose to see

  • Ambient sound design, language-independent experience

Watch

Breathe

Wait

Click

The city reports nothing unusual.

Your screen says otherwise.

Some of the text is created with AI.

The game is extremely experimental and probably doesn't worth it,

so always feel free to ask for a refund.:-)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Need to support OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9995WX
  • Memory: 2048 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Need to support Vulkan
  • Storage: 700 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Need to support OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Any modern 64-bit Linux distribution with glibc 2.31+
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9995WX
  • Memory: 2048 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Need to support Vulkan
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
